source_evidence: separate nonblocking recorder; no retained message/feedback graphs; natural GC unchanged

next_solve_commit: one next solve after matching actual writer send; retain send barrier, single pending candidate and original source times; no additional independent 20 ms physical minimum after the first solve
incomplete_run_policy: retain raw evidence, no certificate, do not advance to next stage
numerical_convergence: QP aggregate plus per-original-row 1e-10 numerical target; original 2e-7 external feasibility, weights and physical constraints unchanged

transport_lifecycle: READY has no actuator output or active-output deadline; actual LiveStart starts consumption freshness supervision with backlog resynchronization; first accepted candidate starts dispatcher output deadlines; active faults remain latched and original thresholds unchanged
native_preparation: native-only packed future MIT arrays and matrix rows; actual candidate propagation and all extrema retained; same C++ physical libraries and independent reference predictor; new source-bound full regression/30 matrix/388 historical qualification
live_diagnostic_snapshot: private zero-FF live policy: candidate quality and actual command checked before publication; complete FF diagnostics and owned copy finish after publication and before synchronous immutable pickle or any next solve; completion failure locks worker and retains explicit incomplete-recording evidence
execution_timing_evidence: bounded in-memory stage timestamps written after shutdown; distinguish engine return, proposal publication, gate entry and diagnostic serialization; original DDS schemas and timestamps retained
source_callback_dispatch: active main executor always nonblocking with unchanged wait arguments; separate depth-one fault executor polled before main work; full-depth original evidence retained
fault_supervision: independent ROS node/executor; matching session and epoch; first fault latched with local callback observation time; complete evidence remains separate
history_timestamp_consistency: C++ command/packet future comparisons use the existing Python 1e-10 second task-relative arithmetic tolerance; source clocks, wall leases, dt limits and original timestamps unchanged
rejected_input_evidence: first rejected admission retained in bounded memory with original source identity; exact gate-input CDR and clocks written only at shutdown
failed_recovery_handoff: failed runs release and verify the sole C++ writer and zero consumption, then require new PX4 ACK and fresh autonomous-Hold status within 350ms before folding; otherwise skip fold and use original LAND; unverified writer exit retains receive-only pumping with no legacy joint publisher; no hardware qualification
source_activity_evidence: preallocated scalar phase wall/thread-CPU and full natural-GC event buffers; pump entry/finally includes first-supervision exceptions; in-memory freeze before recovery; shutdown-only conversion and output; no GC policy, source issue time, receiver, cadence or deadline change
